improvements: Caption should name both the fishpond in the foreground and the church in the distance, and give the 1993 date.
grades.reason: Strongest choice. It shows two features the Examples text names, the former fishpond and the ruined church, together in the valley setting. That makes it more useful than the church-only views.

improvements: Caption should note that the chancel is roofed but the church is otherwise ruined, so the image does not mislead.
Use only as a backup to the fishpond view.
grades.reason: A clear, well-framed view of St Martin's church at Wharram Percy. Part of it still has a roof, so it shows the ruin less plainly than the interior view, and the fishpond does not appear.

improvements: Caption should say this is the roofless interior looking toward the tower.
grades.reason: The roofless interior and tower show clearly that the church is a ruin. It shows only the church, with no fishpond or village setting, so it explains less than the fishpond view.
